codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

items.question: What is the Fortnite Pirate Token?
items.answer: It is an ultra-rare chest drop from the Treasure Hunters season. Activating it makes every V-Bucks item in the shop free for 14 days, and each finder receives two tokens — one valid through December 15, 2026, one through December 31, 2027.

items.question: How rare is the Pirate Token?
items.answer: Epic Games confirms 1 in 137,500 chests for all players. Saturday Treasure Hours add a 1.5x boost to roughly 1 in 91,667, and one confirmed event ran at 2x.

items.question: What is this week's gold outfit?
items.answer: Solid Gold Lil Uzi Vert, revealed Sunday November 8. A new Solid Gold outfit is revealed every Sunday — Week 1 was Solid Gold Rugahand (A$AP Rocky).

items.question: When are Treasure Hours?
items.answer: Every Saturday: 2–4 PM ET and 9–11 PM ET. Both windows boost the chest odds, and the season runs through the December 5 end event.

thisWeek.title: This week's gold outfit: Solid Gold Lil Uzi Vert
thisWeek.body: Revealed Sunday, November 8 — the second of five weekly Solid Gold reveals in the Treasure Hunters season. It only drops from Treasure Hunters chests until the next Sunday reveal replaces it.

odds.title: Official gold outfit odds
odds.baseBody: Epic Games' confirmed per-chest rate — about 0.000064%, the rarest drop in the Treasure Hunters pool and roughly 11 times rarer than the Pirate Shop Access token.
odds.treasureBody: Saturday Treasure Hours apply a 7.5x multiplier — the best window the game ever offers. Each treasure type can drop once per week; Gizmos are unlimited.

how.title: How to get a gold outfit from Treasure Hunters chests
how.body: There is one method: open Treasure Hunters chests on the Crossbones Isle map. Drop at the densest POIs — Rubber Resort and Lantern Landing hold about 47 and 45 chests — sweep every spawn, and grind inside the Saturday windows for the boosted rate.
